title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1971-03-18
source: Recording Info: SBD > R > C > DAT > CD; Transfer Info: CD > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Stunning soundboard capture of a tight original‑five Dead show with standout Pigpen moments on The Rub and the rare Caution, despite occasional audio drops.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers an impressively clear soundboard mix that lets the 1971 five‑man lineup shine, especially Pigpen’s organ and harmonica work. The performance is tight and energetic, highlighted by a classic first set, an extended jam‑heavy second set featuring Truckin', a powerful Caution/Feedback finale, and several rare early ’71 songs. Minor cuts and drops are noted but do not detract from the overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average ~4.4) with praise for both musical performance and sound quality; only minor technical complaints keep the rating just below top‑tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear, acoustic‑feeling mix praised as 'stunning' and 'improved', but a few reviewers note occasional cuts and drops in the audio.

standout_songs: Not Fade Away / Going Down The Road > Caution
show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic first set followed by a jam‑heavy second set; long Truckin' stretch, strong Caution/Feedback finale, with the rare 1971 Caution serving as a centerpiece.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil sings passionately on Uncle John's Band and contributes solid bass throughout.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen is in top form on organ and harmonica, especially on The Rub and the Caution/Feedback segment.
